I have enough to build a rigorous, honest report. The single most important finding is the **Armata overhang**: Innoviva carries a controlling stake in Armata at **$457.7M** (6/30/26) while Armata's *entire* market cap is only **~$167M**. That marked-to-market gap is the engine behind the wild GAAP swings (Q1 +$191M gain, Q2 ~-$146M decline) and is the dominant risk. Everything else (the GSK royalty stream, the IST specialty-pharma business, the $600M cash) is real and verifiable. I'll build a Sum-of-the-Parts with the company-level DCF as a cross-check, and carry the Armata/royalty/guidance uncertainty as wide ranges.

```

INNOVIVA, INC. (INVA) — INTEGRATED INVESTMENT ANALYSIS (RS2 v2.0)
T0 = 2026-08-24 | Price $21.07 | Mkt Cap $1.530B | 72.637M sh

SECTION 0. ANALYSIS OVERVIEW
────────────────────────────
What it is (3 sentences): Innoviva is a diversified biopharma holding
company with (1) a contractual royalty stream on GSK's BREO/RELVAR and
ANORO Ellipta (~$240M/yr, ~80% margin, structurally declining), (2) an
operating specialty-pharma platform "IST" (GIAPREZA, XACDURO, XERAVA,
ZEVTERA, NUZOLVENCE; ~$200M rev run-rate, near-breakeven, growing), and
(3) a strategic investment portfolio dominated by a ~82.7% controlling
stake in micro-cap Armata (ARMP).

Archetype: HYBRID — Archetype A (Stable Incumbent) core [royalty =
bond-like annuity] + Archetype B/C (IST operating growth) + an
ASSET-PLAY overhang (strategic portfolio) + a small Archetype E option
(Nortiva Bio / LYNX). NOT a clean single archetype.

Valuation Engine: BLENDED / SUM-OF-THE-PARTS.
  • Engine 1 (DCF) on the operating business (royalty + IST) — primary.
  • Asset-value (haircut mark) on the strategic portfolio — the Armata
    overhang is a balance-sheet asset, not a DCF.
  • Engine 4 (option) on Nortiva Bio — immaterial, small add.
  • Net cash added at par.
Why blended: a single DCF would either (a) over-value the business by
taking the $669.5M strategic book at face, or (b) under-value it by
letting the Armata mark-to-market noise contaminate the operating FCF.
The honest structure separates the contractual royalty, the operating
IST, the marked-to-market overhang, and cash.

THE CRUX (read first): Innoviva carries Armata at $457.7M [Actual,
6/30/26 PR] but Armata's total market cap is ~$167M [Estimate,

(equity + warrants + secured debt) is worth far less than the $457.7M
carrying value. This is a ~$250M+ overhang that drives the GAAP swings
and is the #1 risk. The market is clearly discounting it heavily.
```
